summary: Describes how to carry audio from the MELPe speech codec in RTP packets. It supports the codec's three encoding rates and frame sizes, and spells out comfort noise and packet loss concealment.

eli5.summary: A talking-robot code squeezes speech into tiny bits. This says how to pack those bits into mail envelopes so the other end can play them back, even if one gets lost.

questions: rtp packet format for melpe codec
